findings.title: Pipeline and state operations can hang instead of failing fast
findings.detail: StateManager.update_pipeline_state wraps sync IO in asyncio.to_thread. _update_pipeline_state_sync calls _pipeline_exists before acquiring another connection. DatabaseManager uses per-path singleton with connection pool and check_same_thread=False. Multiple targeted tests time out rather than fail, confirming the hang hypothesis.

evidence.detail: _update_pipeline_state_sync calls _pipeline_exists which may also acquire connection

findings.recommendation: 1) Isolate update_pipeline_state with a no-LangGraph, no-SDK unit test under 1s. 2) Replace nested connection acquisition with one explicit transaction path. 3) Add bounded timeouts and structured failure logs around every DB update from async flows. 4) Add DatabaseManager.reset_instance() fixture for tests with temporary DB paths.

findings.title: LangGraph completion and cancellation leave async work unclosed

HybridOrchestrator.start_pipeline closes checkpointer connection in finally, but session/task lifecycle is split between orchestrator, CLI service, LangGraph, and node execution. findings.title: Tooling has two parallel implementations
findings.detail: Both legacy and SDK variants exist for file/search/deliverable/context tools. Security tests check file_tools_sdk.PathValidator, while file_tools.PathValidator still uses prefix checks without the same secondary is_relative_to guard. Fixes may land in one implementation but not the other; review and test burden doubles.
findings.recommendation: 1) Pick SDK tools as canonical if Claude Agent SDK is the intended runtime. 2) Move shared validation/path logic into one module and make both wrappers call it during migration. 3) Add a retirement checklist for non-SDK tools.

findings.title: Logging may expose raw user context
findings.detail: HybridOrchestrator.start_pipeline logs full subject_context. Context files may include product plans, credentials, or proprietary text. Logs become harder to share safely during incident debugging.
findings.recommendation: 1) Log subject, context file path, content length/hash, and selected metadata, not full content. 2) Reuse the redaction helpers in utils/logging.py for structured fields.

findings.title: Fire-and-forget state writes risk lost session metadata
findings.detail: _on_session_created schedules state_manager.update_pipeline_state with loop.create_task. The pipeline can continue before session metadata is durable. On cancellation, the task may be destroyed before writing.

findings.recommendation: 1) Return the created task and await it before leaving the node execution boundary. 2) Or make session creation persistence part of SessionManager lifecycle with explicit await.

findings.title: Ruff failures indicate quality gates are not enforced
findings.detail: ruff check autoBMAD/docuswarm found errors (estimated 91 lines). Besides import-order/style issues, the list includes F821 undefined name in runtime code. Obvious runtime issues can reach the working tree; refactors become riskier.
findings.recommendation: 1) Fix F821 first. 2) Then fix or explicitly configure import-order rules for modules with intentional runtime import ordering. 3) Add ruff as a required pre-merge gate once the baseline is clean.
